$comment: Three kinds of entries (规划/04 §9「apps.json 的条目形状」, 规划/03 §4.5, CSB-11). apps: external target apps, the only targets of ext.openApp and of installed detection (BR-ATTR-27 ①); trade_only (required) is true for shopping platforms, and ext.openApp answers 90403 for them so H5 uses trade.convertAndOpen (BR-ATTR-29 细则). sdk_queries: query entries an SDK needs ({source_sdk, ios_scheme, android_package, harmony_scheme}, null where a platform has none). inbound: inbound callbacks, kind custom_scheme {scheme} or verified_link {host, path_prefix, verified: true}, both with purpose, source_sdk (null for our own) and platforms. iOS LSApplicationQueriesSchemes (apps + sdk_queries, ≤ 20), Android <queries>, Harmony querySchemes and every inbound declaration are generated from this file by CT-05; nothing is written by hand. Nothing here is verified yet: app values are candidates from 规划/09 CAP-TB-11, CAP-JD-11, CAP-PDD-11 and CAP-X-04; sdk_queries and inbound stay empty until values are given (our own scheme and domains: 规划/06; the WeChat verified link waits for 06 Q-C12; the Baichuan callback uses our own scheme, CAP-TB-11). Clients never build jump URLs from these values: the server sends primary / fallbacks.
